strings.Made from a template. Mark it up like an: I hangaia mai i tētahi tauira. Tohua ki runga i te āhua o ētahi atu whakaahua.
Kua tāruatia te tohu. Ka whakapiri a Ctrl+V.
strings.No cloud folder (OneDrive, Dropbox, Goog: Kāore i kitea he kōpaki kapua (OneDrive, Dropbox, Google Drive...).
Kāore he kupu i kitea ki reira.
Kāore he mea tairongo i kitea.
strings.Pasted as a piece: drag to move, [ and ]: I whakapirihia hei wāhanga: toia hei nuku, ko te [ me te ] hei whakarerekē i te rahi.
strings.Pinned on top of other windows. Drag to: Kua whakapīnitia ki runga ake i ētahi atu matapihi. Toia hei nuku, pāwhiri rua rānei, pēhia rānei a Esc hei kati.
E pānui ana i te tuhinga...

strings.Recording steps: every click takes a num: E rekoata ana i ngā hāgi: ka hopu whakaahua whai tau te pāwhiri katoa.

strings.Sample picture loaded. Pick a tool on th: Kua uta te whakaahua tauira. Kōwhiria he taputapu ki te taha mauī, ka tuhi ki runga.
strings.Snagster keeps running in the corner of: Kei te haere tonu a Snagster i te kokonga o te pae mahi. Pāwhiri matau i tōna tohu hei puta.
Kāore he anga o taua GIF.
Kāore he whakaahua i te papatopenga.
Kāore anō kia whai mea hei tuku ki tētahi aratohu.

strings.Your mail program is open; drag the pict: Kua tuwhera tō hōtaka īmēra; toia te whakaahua mai i te kōpaki ki roto i te īmēra.
strings.Click: capture this. Wheel: bigger or sm: Pāwhiri: hopukina tēnei. Wīra: wāhanga nui ake, iti iho rānei.
strings.Scrolling: {frames} pictures, {height} p: E panuku ana: {frames} pikitia, {height} pika. Ka mutu mā Esc.
strings.Snagster can't scroll other programs her: Kāore e taea e Snagster te panuku i ētahi atu hōtaka i konei, nā reira me panuku koe, ka pēhi i Whakamutu.
